title: Nutty Snappy Ethiopian Dates Gored-Gored With Basil On Slate-Tile
description: A vegetarian-friendly date-night dish featuring al-dente ethiopian dates with a burst of thai-holy basil krapao on slate-tile, combining nuttiness and snappiness for a memorable meal.
instructions: Place dates in a bowl and crush them with your hands or use a fork until they have an al-dente texture.
In another bowl, mix together crushed dates, walnut pieces, and sesame seeds. Add the basil leaves finely chopped to it.
Transfer the mixture onto slate-tile and serve immediately.
